name: Blue Lake Construction
description:
Blue Lake Construction is a residential remodeling and general contracting company serving homeowners throughout Salt Lake City and the surrounding Salt Lake Valley. Associated with Ryan Gardner a licensed contractor (license number 6085795-5501) and Amy Gardner as the administrative contact for Blue Lake Enterprises Inc., the company focuses on full home remodels, home remodeling, house renovations, condo remodeling, cabin renovations, kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, and home additions with projects ranging from individual room updates to complete property transformations. Its services help homeowners update existing spaces, improve functionality, and create additional room for their changing needs.  

Blue Lake Construction is a residential remodeling and general contracting company co-owned by Ryan Gardner and his wife, serving Salt Lake City and the surrounding Salt Lake Valley. The company provides 
Blue Lake Construction provides full home remodeling for clients planning coordinated improvements throughout their homes. Projects may involve updating multiple rooms, improving interior layouts, refreshing finishes, and integrating kitchen, bathroom, and other living-space renovations into a cohesive project. The company’s approach emphasizes customized planning, craftsmanship, and project management tailored to the homeowner’s goals.

Kitchen remodeling services focus on creating practical, welcoming spaces for cooking, gathering, and everyday living. The company offers custom kitchen designs and installations, with renovations shaped around the client’s space, preferences, and intended use. Bathroom remodeling services include shower installations, cabinet updates, flooring improvements, and changes designed to make bathrooms more functional and visually appealing.

For homeowners who need more space, Blue Lake Construction offers home additions and extensions. These services provide an opportunity to expand an existing home while coordinating the new space with the rest of the property. The company also lists basement remodeling, deck building, and property maintenance among its broader capabilities.

Blue Lake Construction describes its process as collaborative, with craftsmen and project managers working closely with clients throughout construction. Its stated priorities include understanding the customer’s vision, respecting the project budget, and completing work according to agreed specifications. Blue Lake Enterprises’ published business philosophy likewise emphasizes personal attention, trust, and treating customers as a central part of the business.

The company serves communities across the Salt Lake Valley, with published service areas including Salt Lake City, Bluffdale, Cottonwood Heights, Draper, Herriman, Midvale, Riverton, Sandy, South Jordan, West Jordan, and West Valley City. From a kitchen or bathroom renovation to a whole-home remodel or addition, Blue Lake Construction offers a locally focused option for homeowners looking to improve and expand the home they already own.

Main services: kitchen renovations, bathroom renovations, home additions, and complete home remodels. The website describes a team of craftsmen and project managers providing customized construction services. These are the company’s own descriptions, not independently verified assessments.
